reference_portrait.prompt_en: Create the one master character-reference portrait for Lin Yue (林月), the palace archivist, for a fictional Chinese historical suspense drama. Lin Yue has an oval face, straight dark brows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, a small beauty mark below her left eye, black hair in a low braided bun with one narrow pale-jade hairpin, and the same deep teal cross-collar silk hanfu with narrow sleeves and subtle cloud embroidery. About 26, slender build, upright posture, warm ivory skin; center-parted hair; a small dark leather document pouch at her waist. Her expression is alert, restrained, and intelligent, with fear shown only through a small controlled tension around the eyes. Show one woman only, in a waist-up three-quarter portrait with her full unobstructed face, hairpin, neckline, and upper costume clearly visible; calm neutral pose, hands relaxed, no document blocking her face. Use a plain dark archive-wall backdrop so the face and costume can be compared against later images. Fictional Chinese imperial court; dynasty deliberately unspecified. Grounded cinematic historical suspense with textured wood, silk and paper; no fantasy effects. Practical amber lantern and candlelight with cool moonlit shadows. Vertical 9:16 close and medium shots, deliberate slow movement, shallow depth of field. Muted jade, amber, ink black, and desaturated crimson. Produce one portrait still with clean facial detail, natural anatomy, no on-image writing, no modern objects, and no watermark. This exact approved image will be the sole identity reference for all three scene frames.
